set.Finding description: In the global fit for apoE-(1–231), the sedimentation-velocity tetramer signal was 0.33 for apoE4 versus 0.21 for apoE3. The monomer signal was 0.17 versus 0.28, respectively, in local A280 units.

set.Experimental system: Recombinant lipid-free human ApoE4(A102C) and ApoE3(C112S,A102C), labeled separately with Alexa488 or Alexa546 and mixed at a 1:3 donor-to-acceptor ratio. Approximately 15 μM stock was diluted into 20 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl and 0.1% β-mercaptoethanol. ApoE4 final concentrations were 15–480 nM.
